race.comment: TASORAAY (8) only warmed late when resuming at Randwick last month, then hit the line well here last start when stretching to 1400m. Drops back to a trip he loves third-up and is ready to fire. POCKETMONEY (11) finished alongside him in that same race and is a three-time winner here. Drawn sticky but is rock-hard fit and sure to be competitive. EXCEED SPEED (6) resumes off a two-month freshening after a strong first-up third at Ipswich in what has proven a red-hot form reference. Steps to a winning trip second-up and gets another key booking in Thompson. Have to take seriously. PUFF 'N' HARRY (12) is ticking along nicely and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Only needs to hold his form to be thereabouts again.
